notes.title: Cook and Play: Animal Friends hits Early Access on July 4
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to announce that Cook and Play: Animal Friends enters Early Access on July 4! Final tests are nearly complete, and the kitchen is heating up - get ready to jump into the action early and help shape the future of the game.
[/p][p]Expect fast-paced, unpredictable cooking mayhem. From moving counters and kitchen hazards to surprise power-ups, the game throws constant challenges your way. Play solo or team up with a friend - either way, every round is packed with chaos, laughter, and clutch saves.

🔥 Join us on day one of Early Access! Add the game to your wishlist to be notified as soon as it goes live - and be among the first to stir the pot![/p]
